name: Platinic-Serac
description: The crust never rests here. Rivers of incandescent basalt vein the lowlands, ash climbs from vents along every fault, and beyond geothermal vent fields the sky stays the color of a bruise.
Light is the weather here. It swings from merciful to murderous within an hour, and everyone schedules their lives around it.
Local legend among spacers says the planet hums on a frequency just below hearing. Instruments confirm it. Nobody agrees on the source.
Survey contracts pay double for reasons nobody writes down. Veterans read the fine print, then read the survivors.
